lines.text: The Spirit of God came upon Azariah son of Oded, and he went out to meet Asa.
Asa took courage, removed the idols from the land, and restored the altar of the LORD.
Asa assembled Judah, Benjamin, and settlers from Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon, and they gathered in Jerusalem in the second month.
They sacrificed seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep from the plunder they had brought back.
Asa removed his grandmother Maacah as queen mother and burned her Asherah pole in the Valley of Hinnom.
